_comment: Floors for `tools/ci-verify-gate.ts`, which the Required Quality Gate runs after every shard has reported.
Measured on b76dc4ef8fc45994e62f9668649a4cb88ff17ad4, the head this optimisation branched from.
`total` may only ever go UP and `skipped` may only ever go DOWN without a commit that edits this file.
The 49 skips in packages/migrate are the production-dump suites. They are secure-host-only by design:
the dump is git-ignored, never reaches a runner, and those suites skip themselves when it is absent.
The 2 skips in packages/db and the 1 in apps/bot are the legacy/mirzabot-php source checks; `legacy/` is
untracked, so it is absent on every runner and those cases skip there too.
